niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
ai_overview_text:
The best online courses for shadow work and spiritual practice blend psychological depth with soulful integration, ranging from structured Jungian platforms to accessible guided audio programs.
Details: A 4-class, 4-hour on-demand program priced at $127.
Focus: Explores Jungian shadow formation, projection in relationships, and patterns driven by the unconscious to foster psychological responsibility. Jung Platform
Details: A beginner-friendly, 2-hour video course with 48 lectures and practical exercises.
Focus: Identifies triggers, inner reflection, transforming fear and anger, and communicating with the shadow self. Udemy
Details: Self-paced digital courses blending modern science, emotional healing, and spiritual wisdom (such as The Spirituality of Internal Family Systems).
Focus: Somatic practices and unscripted teachings from visionary authors and spiritual leaders. Sounds True +2
Details: A multi-week multimedia course exploring the dark, golden, ancestral, and sexual shadows.
Focus: Integrates lucid dreaming, Tibetan Buddhist practices (like Tonglen), and daytime mask work. www.awakeacademy.org +1
Details: Short, accessible audio courses like Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth (Sefy Tofan) or Into The Light: A Journey Through Shadow Work.
Focus: Daily 10-minute somatic awareness exercises, trigger tracking, and gentle inner-child healing. Insight Timer +1
Are you looking for free or paid options?
Do you prefer a purely psychological (Jungian) approach or a spiritual/meditative blend?
